name: folder-ellipsis
description: A complete folder containing three separate dots.
useCase: Open additional actions for a folder.
misuse: Label the folder action explicitly; arrows depict fixed physical directions.

16.reason: The full folder and tab stay unchanged; the complete dot row moves a quarter unit right and down so all three equal dots remain equally clear at native size.

24.reason: The full shared folder and complete content marker retain their direction and generous separation.
